description: Source code for MAP (Manifold Absolute Pressure) averaging in an engine control system, including ADC callback handling, trigger scheduling, and pressure calculation.

methods.name: startAveraging
methods.description: Initializes MAP averaging process, resets accumulators, and sets the averaging flag.

methods.name: mapAveragingAdcCallback
methods.description: Handles ADC value updates, accumulates ADC readings, and optionally logs data for sensor chart.

methods.name: endAveraging
methods.description: Finalizes MAP averaging, computes average pressure, updates buffer, and resets flags.

methods.name: applyMapMinBufferLength
methods.description: Configures the buffer length for MAP averaging and initializes buffer values.

methods.name: postMapState
methods.description: Outputs current MAP averaging state to Tuner Studio.

methods.name: refreshMapAveragingPreCalc
methods.description: Pre-calculates start and duration for MAP averaging based on RPM and engine configuration.

methods.name: mapAveragingTriggerCallback
methods.description: Schedules start and end of MAP averaging based on shaft position trigger events.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the current MAP value, either raw or averaged, depending on configuration.

methods.name: initMapAveraging
methods.description: Initializes MAP averaging subsystem, registers trigger listener, and sets up console commands.
